title: RGB Paintbrush
description: Unlimited RGB brush! Press J to pick any color, left-click to paint ANY block.
body:
🎨 Color ANY block in ANY RGB color!

Tired of the same 16 wool colors? This mod lets you paint any block in any of 16+ million shades — perfect for builders, map makers, and creative players.

How to use:
1. Get the paintbrush (Creative mode or craft it)
2. Press J to open the RGB color picker
3. Left-Click on any block to paint it
4. Right-Click on a painted block to copy its color

Instructions:
Left-Click — Paint block 
Right-Click — Copy color 
J — Open color picker 

Main Feature:
Paint any block in any RGB color

Why use this mod?
Builders can create precise color schemes, gradients, and details that vanilla blocks simply don't offer.

To use this mod, you must install Fabric API.
